notes.content:

notes.title: The WACKY CHEATS Update - Including a playable raptor mode!
notes.content:
WACKY CHEATS!

Featuring
Raptor Jerma
Play as a raptor.
Shoot lasers. Aim lasers up and down.
Use lasers to reflect other projectiles.

Fast Jerma
Go fast.

Quick Attack
Spam your attacks.

Roll Attack
Roll into enemies to hurt them.
Roll into crates to destroy them.

Purple Jerma
Turns Jerma purple.

Double Jump
Can jump twice.

Die Instantly
Press "R" to DIE instantly.
Works anywhere, anytime.
(May break the game)


Description
The game's been out for a while, so I decided I just wanted to mess around and break things with in-game cheats. Enjoy.

You can toggle the cheats on or off at any time during the game using the settings menu within the pause menu. You can also enable multiple at once and they should all function together (which makes the gameplay VERY stupid). Some achievements/stats are locked out if you used cheats at any point during a game session.

This update also adds in the content added during the behind-the-scenes video (Video Link) like a new Jerma dance and Jerma joke audio line. The credits are finally updated as well since the behind-the-scenes was finally finished.

This was very fun to make. Thanks to the game's discord (Discord Link) for giving me some of the cheat ideas.


Also, this is the last planned content update to "Jerma's Big Adventure".
Thanks to everyone for playing the game!


(If you would like to follow my other projects, including an upcoming free "Chapter 1" demo of my main game project, check out my Youtube or my newly used Twitter account for updates, eventually)

notes.title: v.1.2.2 Minor bug fixes - No longer get hit by reflected projectiles
notes.content:
Very small update. Feel free to move along and ignore this.

v1.2.2 Changes

 When you reflect lasers, you can no longer get hit by the reflected laser UNLESS it is reflected back at you by a certain enemy boss
 When you reflect electric orb projectiles, you won't be able to get hit by it until the orb bounces off of a surface or is reflected back at you by a certain enemy boss
 Fixed game breaking bug where dying or restarting at a checkpoint in psycho mode in the first red region would cause weird broken cutscene behavior that could lock away the camera
 Fixed minor visual bug where background mushrooms would briefly flash on the screen when moving between some regions


The behind-the-scenes video is coming soon and there will be a small update alongside it. The behind-the-scenes will reveal the dark, shocking TRUTH behind Jerma's Big Adventure. Big event. Be there. It'll be posted to youtube.com/worblir when it's done.

Also, Jerma played the game which is very cool. Thanks Jerma and everyone for playing the game!

notes.title: v.1.2.1 Small fix to hopefully improve performance
notes.content:
This is a very small update that shouldn't change gameplay but should hopefully improve performance.

If you notice any problems (or improvements) with this update, you can leave a comment.

v1.2.1 Changes

 Changed how sections are loaded within the cave to hopefully fix some performance issues (which was especially an issue in psycho mode)
 Projectiles should no longer pass through enemies if reflected right next to the enemy


Another performance-related minor update will be coming soon that should include some graphics options (e.g. options for decreased particles, no post-processing, etc.) and maybe a few other small features like an option in the pause menu to restart from the start of the game (without going through the main menu first).

Also, I'm still working on that behind-the-scenes video. It's going to be real gnarly. It'll be posted to youtube.com/worblir

notes.title: PSYCHO Mode - New Game Mode Out Now!
notes.content:
Attention Jermamites

The ultimate Jerma-related gamer challenge is out NOW.

After completing the game once, you can now play the hardcore, remixed version of the game called PSYCHO mode.

Select PSYCHO as the Game Mode within the New Game screen on the main menu to try it out!
(The New Game screen is accessible after beating the game at least once)

v1.2 Change Log

Psycho Mode

 A remixed version of all the levels seen in the normal game
 Reworked enemy AI (especially with raptors) that are more aggressive and reactive than before
 A variety of visual and environmental changes
 Two new achievements!
 A new, single ending for completing PSYCHO mode
 No tutorials and very few cutscenes, only gamer time
 Jerma wears sunglasses
 Pain


General Changes/Fixes

 When Jerma is ducked and on the ground with an enemy above him, releasing the duck button will bounce enemies up into the air
 When Jerma is ducked with a box above him, releasing the duck button will destroy all boxes blocking him from getting back up
 The in-game timer now stops during ALL cutscenes in the game. The in-game timer now will only count time where 
 Projectiles should hopefully be more consistent at lower-frame rates and projectiles should no longer occasionally explode immediately after hitting them
 Jerma can't swing his bat while shocked now


Also, check out the two new achievements!

PSYCHO
Finish a PSYCHO stream

notes.title: PSYCHO Mode - Upcoming Update Announcement
notes.content:
Attention Jermamites

No more pushover raptors. PSYCHO mode will be the ultimate Jerma-related gamer challenge. Coming soon.

I'm working on a larger update to the game that will add a new difficulty mode called PSYCHO that will expand on the enemy AI to make them more aggressive (no more pushover raptors) alongside at least one new achievement related to the new difficulty mode.

I'll also be messing around with some of the visuals and probably a few other things to give the PSYCHO mode the right vibe. The above ground region will especially be given a new distinct look in the PSYCHO mode, at the very least.

DELAY ANDY: I need a bit more time on this but it's still coming soon.

Also, as said in the credits of the game, I will be working on a behind-the-scenes video for Jerma's Big Adventure which will reveal a lot of details and secrets and explain what drove me to make this thing. That'll be uploaded on my youtube channel: https://www.youtube.com/worblir

More updates can be found on the discord server: https://discord.com/invite/gnKWbCxZeg

Also, thanks for playing my game! This was a lot more attention than I was expecting and it's been fun to see people's reactions to this overkill meme game.
